intent: Base representation of a command as it moves through the cluster: wire-format request/response, a cross-node id, completion flag, and escalation timing; BedrockCommand builds on top of it.

objects.name: SQLiteCommand
objects.role: holds request/response/id/timing for a command; move-only via a private backing field for the const `request` reference

objects.name: SQLiteCommand::preprocessRequest
objects.role: assigns a requestID and warns on deprecated commandExecuteTime, run before `request` is bound

misfits.why: deprecation-specific handling of one legacy wire field living inside an otherwise generic request-preprocessing helper

location_fit.note: correctly the base type alongside the rest of sqlitecluster.

naming_quality.note: private backing field is named `privateRequest` instead of the repo's usual `_` prefix (e.g. `_request`), inconsistent with the rest of the codebase's own convention.
